evidence: Open-access article. Initial LOI of Cotton-PDTSP-1T is 24.2%. TG/DTG under nitrogen at 10 °C/min; both PDTSP-coated states begin 5% mass loss at 279 °C and show Tmax at 319 °C.
source_title: Preparation and Mechanism of Flame-Retardant Cotton Fabric with Phosphoramidate Siloxane Polymer through Multistep Coating
limitations: As-prepared state only. Char yields are described as approximate/threshold values and are not entered. Washed LOI values are excluded.
